resources.string: Review how SignPDF handles document, advertising, and purchase data.

SignPDF Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-08-20

1. Documents and images
PDFs and images are processed on your device to open PDFs, unlock protected PDFs, sign, annotate, convert images to PDF, merge PDFs, manage, extract or split pages, and save results. Document contents and PDF passwords are not uploaded to a server. Results are saved as new PDFs without overwriting the original.

2. Recent files and saved signatures
Recent file names, formats, Android file URIs, and signatures saved with Pro may be stored locally on your device for convenience. You can remove these local records by deleting the relevant item or app data.

3. Advertising
The free version may use Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob). Google advertising services may process information such as IP address, device and advertising identifiers, ad interactions, diagnostics, and performance information for ad delivery, measurement, and fraud prevention. Where required, Google UMP provides consent and ad privacy choices. In-app banner ads are not shown to Pro users.

4. In-app purchase
SignPDF Pro is offered as a one-time Google Play in-app purchase. Payment, purchase verification, and restore are handled by Google Play Billing. SignPDF does not directly collect or store complete payment details such as card numbers.

5. Free usage limit
Free users can complete up to 10 successful output creation or save operations per monthly cycle. Usage count and reset timing are stored locally on the device. Pro users are not subject to this limit.

6. Data sale
SignPDF does not sell document contents or personal information to advertisers.

7. Children
SignPDF is not specifically designed for children.

8. Security and limitations
SignPDF is a document editing utility and is not a certified electronic-signature authority, electronic-contract certification service, or legal identity-verification service. Check the save location and recipients when handling sensitive documents.

9. Changes and contact
This policy may be updated when app features, SDKs, or applicable policies change. For privacy questions, use the developer contact email listed on Google Play.
